07136 qarah {kaw-raw'}

字根型; TWOT - 2068,2068e; 動詞

欽定本 - happen 7, meet 5, beams 4, befall 3, brought 1, misc 7; 27

1) 遇見, 見面, 臨到
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) 遇見, 見面
       1a2) 臨到
   1b) (Niphal)
       1b1) 遇見, 見面 (沒有經過事先安排)
       1b2) 碰巧出現
   1c) (Hiphil) 使發生
2) 架設樑木
   2a) (Piel) 安置樑木, 架樑

07136 qarah {kaw-raw'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 2068,2068e; v

AV - happen 7, meet 5, beams 4, befall 3, brought 1, misc 7; 27

1) to encounter, meet, befall, happen, come to meet
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) to encounter, meet
       1a2) to befall
   1b) (Niphal)
       1b1) to encounter, meet (without pre-arrangement)
       1b2) to chance to be present
       1b3) to come to meet
   1c) (Hiphil) to cause to meet, appoint
2) to build with beams
   2a) (Piel) to lay the beams of, furnish with beams
